meta.title: An awarded event: "Recreate Order": "Create Order" with the values it opens with goes through

steps.note: Open the prepared awarded event on its project summary page.
Open the RFQ stage before accessing its Responses tab and Settings menu.
Navigate to the RFQ Responses view specified by the case.
Open the RFQ Settings menu and choose Recreate Order, leaving the resulting window open.

args.goal: save the Recreate Order window using the values it opened with, then stop when the window closes and the screen shows the New Order Created confirmation

steps.note: Submit the prefilled Recreate Order form without changing its values and verify the resulting screen evidence.
Assert the expected successful order-creation confirmation.
